aboutGame.title: What is Invokyr?
paragraphs: Invokyr is a co-op survival horror game built around a cursed 1970s board game. You and up to five friends are trapped in a groaning manor where a bitter, whimsical Gamemaster invites you to play, and every roll of the dice can summon a trap, a curse, or a creature that hunts in its own way. The house is a labyrinth split into jungle, ice mountain, and oversized toy chest biomes, and losing your way back to the board can end a run.

Escape is never a single switch. Your team has to recover golden idols, spend limited single-use dice wisely, clear stacked curses, and carry the board game itself into the final room before the spoken ending will trigger. Invokyr enters Steam Early Access on October 8, 2026, developed and published by Ludogram, with a free demo already available so you can learn the dice economy before launch.

modules.name: Invokyr Wiki Beginner Guide
modules.description: A starter path through the cursed board game covering table setup, turn order, dice discipline, and the first-run loop that keeps a squad alive.

highlights.detail: Place the board game on the table and roll to reveal the first spaces.
Search rooms in pairs and mark a route back to the central board.
Recover golden idols and convert them into single-use dice.
Read every dice result before anyone moves or commits.
Clear stacked curses before pushing deeper into a new biome.
Regroup at the board and confirm every objective before the finale.

modules.description: Co-op roles, dice ownership, and voice discipline for squads of one to six players trying to survive the Gamemaster together.

highlights.detail: Pick a role before the first roll so dice end up with the right player.
Assign one player to track every single-use die the team is carrying.
Keep voice contact and call out the room you are entering.
Regroup at the board before anyone commits to a risky roll.
Revive downed teammates early, because death is not always the end.
Confirm the board game is with the party before the final room.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Invokyr.

items.question: What is Invokyr?
items.answer: Invokyr is a co-op survival horror game built around a cursed 1970s board game. You and up to five friends explore a labyrinthine manor, roll single-use dice, recover golden idols, and try to escape before the Gamemaster's creatures and cursed rules wipe the squad.

items.question: How many players can play Invokyr?
items.answer: Invokyr supports online co-op for one to six players. Solo runs are possible but demand much tighter dice budgeting, because there is no one to revive you or cover a room.

items.question: When does Invokyr release?
items.answer: Invokyr enters Steam Early Access on October 8, 2026, with a simultaneous global unlock. A free demo launched on June 2, 2026, so you can learn the board and dice systems before launch day.

items.question: What platforms is Invokyr on?
items.answer: Invokyr is confirmed for Windows PC via Steam. Console, macOS, Linux, and Switch versions have not been announced, and Steam Deck compatibility is still unrated.

items.question: How do you win in Invokyr?
items.answer: To escape in Invokyr, your squad must bring the physical board game into the final room and have voice input enabled so the spoken ending phrase registers. Missing either requirement keeps the finale silent.

items.question: Are the dice reusable in Invokyr?
items.answer: No. Every die recovered from the house is a single-use item, which is why dice discipline and role assignments matter more than raw speed in Invokyr.
